name: PartyTargetWatch
release_type_reason: All focus and chat-announcement features have been removed after user-reported Mythic+ failure. Current-target monitoring remains; version 0.5.0 has not been verified in-game.
icon_rights: Original vector artwork created for PartyTargetWatch, distributed under the MIT License; no third-party game, platform, or addon artwork used.
not_live_verified: Version 0.5.0 loading, compact settings and saved-setting migration
Current-target monitoring in parties, raids, combat and Mythic+
Target raid markers, scene visibility and background opacity
Minimap button collection and native Settings category
compatibility_note: Displays current targets and raid markers through game-permitted UI APIs. No focus-unit reads, chat listeners, announcement parsing, chat sends or addon messages remain.
upgrade_note: Clear shareFocus, showFocus, acceptFocusCalls and declarationFormats on load; preserve other preferences. Replace the addon directory to remove retired Communication.lua and Bindings.xml. Keep WTF/SavedVariables. The release contains 7 files.

checks: Changing scale from 100% to 110% and back to 100%
Updating the player's own selected-target name

background_opacity.affects: Background, border and row fills only; text and icons remain visible.

current_user_observations: The user reports that focus-related features fail in Mythic+ and requested their removal. Earlier local name/icon feedback does not establish Mythic+ support.

ui_entry_points.eui_compatibility_basis: Inspected local GatherMinimapButtons selects named direct Minimap child Buttons, with a nonnumeric name ending and width >= 20. The new button allows collector reparenting and resizing; live behavior awaits reload verification.
